purpose: Track API / CLI / MCP capabilities as verifiable MorroWise system components with update history, boundaries, owner tasks, and next actions.

discovery.rule: Any harness-mc session handling API / CLI / MCP capabilities must check this registry before relying on chat, memory, Heptabase, Canvas, or local runtime assumptions.

status_values.ready: Capability has a clear entrypoint, boundary, owner task, verifier, and current history.
status_values.blocked: Capability cannot be used until blocker is resolved.
status_values.legacy: Capability remains documented as fallback or history, not normal path.
status_values.prototype: Capability is being shaped and must not be treated as stable infrastructure.
status_values.unknown: Capability was reported or discovered but lacks enough verified metadata.
